title: Filtering and Pagination
description: Add filtering, sorting, and pagination to GraphQL queries.
longDescription: Large datasets require filtering and pagination. This module teaches you how to add automatic filtering with [UseFiltering], cursor and offset pagination with [UsePaging], and optimize database queries for performance.
whatYouLearn: How to enable automatic filtering with [UseFiltering]
How to implement cursor and offset pagination
How to build custom filter inputs
How to optimize pagination with keyset and indexes
